newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent firmer as NYMEX crude rises on APIs.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent firmer as NYMEX crude rises on APIs.

text.p: Brent crude futures trading in Asia were firmer on Wednesday as NYMEX crudes reacted bullishly to overnight U.S. stock data.
Brent for January last traded on SIMEX at $22.90 per barrel, after London firmed 12 cents to settle at $22.74.
Brokers said NYMEX complex was up after American Petroleum Institute (API) data on Tuesday.
"It's quite clear that ACCESS is firmer compared to this morning on the back of supportive API numbers," a broker said.
NYMEX January crude futures, which rose 13 cents in New York to $23.62 per barrel, was last traded on ACCESS at $23.82.
The API data showed a fall in crude stocks of 2.03 million barrels after refinery operating rates hit 93.7 percent from a week earlier 92.9 percent.

Heating oil was also boosted by data showing heating oil stocks fell just more than one million barrels in the East Coast. However, overall distillate stocks were 660,000 barrels higher with distillate output at near record levels of 3.61 million barrels per day (bpd).
December heating oil, which dropped 0.99 cent in New York, clawed back 0.51 cent of the losses on ACCESS to stand at 71.75 per gallon. --Singapore Newsroom (+65 870 3081)
